parsed.notes: The filing states only that the covenants exist and that the Company was in compliance as of October 2, 2026. It gives no actual ratio values and no numeric limits. The net leverage ratio is also used to set the interest rate margin and the unused commitment fee; those uses are not covenants and are excluded.
